description: Give a person or a role access to one account, change the level, or remove it (access_right 'none'). Levels: read (see), write (also send / change / file), manage (also change credentials and hand out access). The owner always has full access and cannot be assigned. For a runner, resource_id is the user id of the person whose runner it is. For an agent (resource_type 'agent'), resource_id is the agent id: read or more lets that person or role see and use the agent (same as the team page, 'Account access', kind Agent). Name exactly one target: user_id (a person), role (fixed role admin/planner/viewer/caller) or tenant_role_id (a web role). Tenant admin, or someone with manage on that account (for an agent also its creator).

access_right.description: Access level; none removes the access

resource_type.description: Type of the account access is granted to

role.description: Fixed role to grant access to (instead of user_id or tenant_role_id)

name: set_account_access
